name: certificate-manager-gcp
description: Certificate management system on Google Cloud

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emulators,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:emulators" "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/api" "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/web"
scripts.dev:lite: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/api" "npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/web"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n emulators,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:emulators" "until curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:9099/ >/dev/null && curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:8081/ >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; npm run seed:dev && DB_ADAPTER=firestore STORAGE_ADAPTER=fs EMAIL_PROVIDER=file QUEUE_ADAPTER=in-process FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8081 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/api" "VITE_USE_AUTH_EMULATOR=true npm run dev -w @certificate-manager/web"
scripts.test:e2e:auth: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-certificate-manager "export E2E_DATA_DIR=$(mktemp -d) && export STORAGE_FS_ROOT=\$E2E_DATA_DIR/storage && npm run seed:dev && E2E_AUTH_EMULATOR=true E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD=local-admin-password VITE_USE_AUTH_EMULATOR=true npm run test:e2e -w @certificate-manager/web"
